messages.subject: Plot size
parts:
HI i'm new to knitr and think it's awesome. However, i would like to make figures to span most of the page, but when i try doing it with figure.width and figure.height, the only effect is that the canvas or viewport becomes bigger and the fonts in the plot decrease in size. Is there are way achieve this?

thanks

messages.author: 8502567f9dbc7c7e
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Plot size
parts:
This sounds like Rnw files, not Rmd. Try changing the margin size using the LaTeX "geometry" package (e.g. [1]). In fact, a lot of frustrations with what you think of as "knitr" come from lack of familiarity with LaTeX. I am no expert at LaTeX (I started using it because knitr uses it), but the time I have spent Googling LaTeX and reading tutorials has solved most of the issues I have had using knitr.

[1] http://www.sharelatex.com/learn/Page_size_and_margins
